input: Content target of the active project; a Ton or Off segment from the chosen clip, the player-confirmed source IN/OUT and the confirmed source timebase.
output: story_parts, story_markers and story_state writes through the serialized content write transport; reads of segments (deleted ones for the Segment tab), all markers with the locked start and end, stored M-M slots (marker pair, has_cover) and the stored selection. The program model is the active segments on one axis, markers, slots, story timebase, total length, duration labels, v5 navigation (segment, slot, marker, first empty slot); navigation only asks for a program frame (take_seek) and draws the Wrap playhead given by qnc-wrap-session. It never chooses a source clip for the player. Covers (v5 quick_cover / overwrite_cover): B / Cover slot writes CreateCover for the selected empty slot, Overwrite for the selected slot or the selected cover's slot, from the source the caller marks (clip, confirmed IN/OUT, player timebase); the store makes it a B-roll virtual shot. Covers are drawn over their slot; a cover click selects it, a segment choice clears it, Delete takes marker, then cover, then segment. take_program_changed tells the Wrap view that segments or covers changed.
